name: smwmusic-twinkle-treachery
title: Twinkle Treachery
description:
An original song composed for NopeContest and I's KLDC2021 level, Hazy Halls.

The level in question's a cloudy, purple ghost house, and that's pretty much the vibe I went for when composing, but alongside a sense of determination too.

Most of the song is upbeat, with a small calm bit in the middle, with everything separated by some messy parts. It's also sparkly.

Probably best suited for longer levels, specifically un-serious ones, I guess?
